method: Native SVG lighting from current-minus-baseline designed-height gradients. Mask follows the union of all changed height-raster cells plus16-block blending,including the Sacred Mountain approach and shoulder changes. Original raster textures retained; no raw raster image edited.
light_direction_rule: Normal(-dx,1,-dz) under northwest light adds positive(dx+dz). Signed light=clamp(0.18*(delta_dx+delta_dz),-0.16,0.16);alpha quantized1/4096.
limits: The R68 preparation radius,automatic first-air and shoulder/approach heights changed. This is an illustrative lighting update from bilinear samples of normal height inputs,not a metric heightmap,runtime sampler or canon sanctuary architecture. Other depicted ridge/tree strokes remain stylised; runtime fit and early-era residents are not tested.
